shellCommands.command: cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/SKILL.md && ls -R .agents | head -50 && cat AGENTS.md && ls && cat package.json 2>/dev/null; git ls-files

cat src/App.tsx src/main.tsx index.html vite.config.ts tsconfig.json; ls __agent_eval__; head -40 .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md; .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit ThemeProvider Switch useThemeValue useTheme SegmentedRadioGroup

bash .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit ThemeProvider Switch useTheme useThemeValue SegmentedRadioGroup 2>&1 | head -60; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build 2>/dev/null

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit && cat README.md | head -80; ls build/esm | head; ls build/esm/components/theme build/esm/components/Switch build/esm/components/SegmentedRadioGroup 2>&1

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components && cat theme/ThemeProvider.d.ts theme/types.d.ts theme/useTheme.d.ts theme/useThemeType.d.ts theme/useThemeValue.d.ts theme/useThemeSettings.d.ts theme/ThemeContext.d.ts; cat Switch/Switch.d.ts SegmentedRadioGroup/SegmentedRadioGroup.d.ts; grep -n -i 'theme\|Switch\|Segmented' ../index.d.ts ../components/index.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head
cd /tmp && curl -sS -m 20 -o uikit7.txt -w '%{http_code} %{content_type}\n' https://gravity-ui.com/llms/uikit/7/llms.txt; wc -c uikit7.txt; head -c 600 uikit7.txt

cd /home/sandbox/workspace && grep -n -A12 'interface ControlProps\b\|interface ControlProps ' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/types.d.ts; rg -n -i -C 3 'useThemeType|useTheme\b|switch|toggle|system' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/theming.md | head -80

cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/index.d.ts; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components | tr '\n' ' '; grep -n 'variant\|color' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Text/Text.d.ts | head; cat .gitignore

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components && grep -n 'gap\|direction\|alignItems\|justifyContent\|spacing' layout/Flex/Flex.d.ts | head; grep -n 'view\|type\b\|theme' Card/Card.d.ts | head; grep -n "export type TextBaseVariants\|'subheader-\|'header-" ../../esm/components/text/*.d.ts Text/**/*.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -5

cd /home/sandbox/workspace && python3 - <<'EOF'
p='src/main.tsx'
s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace("import { ThemeProvider } from '@gravity-ui/uikit';\n","")
s=s.replace("import { App } from './App';","import { App } from './App';\nimport { AppThemeProvider } from './AppThemeProvider';")
s=s.replace('<ThemeProvider theme="light">','<AppThemeProvider>').replace('</ThemeProvider>','</AppThemeProvider>')
open(p,'w').write(s)
EOF
cat src/main.tsx; npm run build 2>&1 | tail -20
